verified_facts.text: Andaz Prague is a lifestyle hotel set in the historic Sugar Palace building.
verified_facts.excerpt: Andaz Prague, a lifestyle hotel nestled in the iconic Sugar Palace

verified_facts.text: The hotel sits in the heart of Prague's historical center.
verified_facts.excerpt: sits right in the heart of Prague’s historical center

verified_facts.text: Old Town Square is a short walk from the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: Just a short walk brings you to the famous Old Town Square and other must-see landmarks.

verified_facts.text: Rooms carry design references to Prague legends, including Bruncvik's lion above the bedpost and Princess Libuse.
verified_facts.excerpt: Sleep well in our elegant king room guarded by Bruncvík’s lion above the bedpost or reach for a star as princess Libuše did, paying tribute to one of many legends that inspired the story of Andaz Prague.

verified_facts.text: Some king rooms have a private balcony overlooking St. Henry's churchyard.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy your unique private balcony overlooking St. Henry’s churchyard in this king room

verified_facts.text: The Wintergarden Suites are built around a winter garden and have high ceilings.
verified_facts.excerpt: Experience a breathtaking and unique winter garden that sits at the heart of this elegant suite. Made for pure relaxation, it features high ceilings

verified_facts.text: The Presidential Suite has original moldings, high ceilings, a marble fireplace and a winter garden.
verified_facts.excerpt: Original moldings adorn the walls of high-ceilinged rooms, and a stunning marble fireplace with a decorative mirror sits at its heart, together with a unique winter garden

verified_facts.text: The Wintergarden Equilibrium Suite includes a private gymnasium.
verified_facts.excerpt: Discover elevated comforts, such as a private gymnasium, in this luxurious suite

verified_facts.text: The Junior Suite has art deco design influences.
verified_facts.excerpt: personifies contemporary sophistication with its art deco design influences

verified_facts.text: The Family Room has connecting king and twin bedrooms overlooking a quiet courtyard.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy the family option with this contemporary room featuring connecting king and twin bedrooms. Complete with thoughtful details and overlooking a quiet courtyard

verified_facts.text: ZEM is an avant-garde Czech bistro whose menu blends Czech produce with occasional Japanese flavors, cooked over charcoal and steam.
verified_facts.excerpt: The menu is a creative blend of Czech produce with occasional hints of Japanese flavors, crafted from a theatrical kitchen stage of charcoal and steam.

verified_facts.text: MEZ Bar serves cocktails inspired by Bohemian mythology.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our mixologists reconnect with nature to surprise you with perfectly balanced cocktails infused with the ancient power and wisdom of Bohemian mythology.

verified_facts.text: The hotel hosts Le Petit Chef and Friends, an immersive 3D mapping dinner show.
verified_facts.excerpt: Join us for an unforgettable immersive 3D mapping dinner show

verified_facts.text: The hotel is pet friendly and offers a VID (Very Important Dog) service.
verified_facts.excerpt: For guests traveling with a dog, we offer a VID (Very Important Dog) service.

verified_facts.text: Room service is available at any time of day.
verified_facts.excerpt: No matter the time of the day, we’ll bring you delicious classics from international and Czech cuisine to fully enjoy in the privacy of your room with our Room Service.

verified_facts.text: Some suites overlook the Dancing Fountain, Haymarket or Jindrisska Tower.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our Junior Suite, which overlooks the Dancing Fountain, Haymarket, or Jindřišská Tower

verified_facts.text: Vaclav Havel Airport Prague is 7.5 miles from the hotel.
